characters.description: Head of the Nagato clan and guildmaster of Silverfangs, an Emperor-class adventurer with a sealed demon secondary class. He comes back from a summer in the elven world with his party and is about to start his second year at Halen. He has the rare Portal skill but cannot open one himself yet, and the remnants of Kaiming are hunting him.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: Ken's instructor at Halen and a fearsome high-level fighter whose Limit Break turns her berserk. Her new red hair dye failed the moment Limit Break activated. On the way home she admits she deliberately took the blood of the floor-45 demon boss, which is linked to Ken's sealed demon class. She claims her Limit Break came from a floor-28 lightning bird, though Ken suspects she is hiding part of the truth.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: An elf and the party's tank, fighting with a glaive, camouflage and roots. She returns from the elven world with Ken, who swapped skills with her over the summer, and Ken's grandfather treats her as his favorite granddaughter. She takes her duty of keeping Ken safe very seriously.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: Ken's partner and party mage. Over the summer she trained deep in the dungeon with her parents, unlocked a demonic heritage, and changed from warlock to demonic mage with a Temptress secondary class. Her eyes are now pink, and the covered one has a heart-shaped pupil.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: A druid in Ken's party and one of his partners. She spent the summer training hard under her mother and has gained the ability to revive the dead, which makes her the group's safety net. She can understand her rabbit companion and passes on what he says.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: Charlotte's giant rabbit. Over the summer he was retrained as a dodge tank, with skills for taunting, evading and moving quickly, though he still has trouble keeping enemies focused on him.
characters.name: Bun-Bun

characters.description: A masked butler in the service of the Nagato family who looks after Ken and reports back to his grandfather. She travels with the group on the walk home through the dungeon.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: Ken's grandmother, an elder of the Nagato clan who can teleport inside a cloud of mist. She walks back to the Nagato estate with Ken's party after the summer.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: Ken's grandfather and an elder of the Nagato clan. He carries Ken to the estate and settles terms with him about leaving Crimson and Ken's class partners alone. He is very fond of Fayeth, and Amy reports to him.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: An elf princess Ken became partnered with during his summer in the elven world, and one of the people he swapped skills with. She stays in her own world, but Ken says he may bring her into his group later.
characters.name: The elf princess

characters.description: Head of the Halen academy. She is stern and dislikes being ordered around by Crimson, but she owes Crimson favors and so agrees to portal Ken's group to school at the last minute.
characters.name: The headmistress

characters.description: Head of the UG. With angel summons backing him, he personally leads the raid that destroys Kaiming's last safe house on the surface.
characters.name: The UG president

characters.description: A senior figure in what remains of Kaiming. He is a caster who uses debuffs and snake venom and can open portals. When the UG takes his last surface safe house, he escapes through a portal into a dungeon and swears to get revenge on Ken.
characters.name: The Kaiming leader

characters.description: A bard in Ken's party, Class 2A, who dreams of having a harem of healers. Her strong mana regeneration is valuable for the coming raid. She finds out that Ken did sleep with the elf princess.
characters.name: Harley

characters.description: A notorious woman with a large harem who joins Halen's staff at the start of the year and takes over a second-year class. Crimson silences her at the entrance ceremony. She is Helen's mother, and her students have already built a luxurious school building on floor 30. Ken has said he wants nothing to do with her.
characters.name: The harem queen

characters.description: A Class 2A tank who has a revive skill, and the daughter of the harem queen. Dez says Helen wrote the smutty serial "74 Wives" to get back at her mother and to get into Silverfangs.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A Class 2A classmate of Ken's who fights as a frost knight tank.
characters.name: Penny

characters.description: A blonde Class 2A student who answers the teachers' questions and whose mother leads a guild. She explains that death rates at the top colleges are expected to climb steeply under the new standards.
characters.name: Candace

characters.description: A Class 2A classmate of Ken's.
characters.name: Taylor

characters.description: A monster that appears only when the dungeon focuses on Ken. It is huge and dark, throws off purple sparks, and teleports. Other attacks pass straight through it, and only Ken's blades can hurt it. When Charlotte heals him, it speeds up and kills him in an instant before disappearing.
characters.name: The panther

characters.description: A cat-people shaman Ken met over the summer. She tattooed him and has a big mane, blue stripes and revealing clothes. Dez bets that she will come looking for him.
characters.name: The cat-people shaman

characters.description: A healer in Candace's party with short black hair, whose skills drain souls. She is the one who suggests Helen's mother as a possible partner for Ken, and the group teases him about it.
characters.name: Selene

characters.description: The tank in Candace's party, fighting with a mace and shield.
characters.name: Myrtle

characters.description: A cocky, strong berserker from a rich family, and the center of the startup party Crimson scouted for when she was young. He lied to the party, and on a candy-themed floor a lightning phoenix drove him into a rage. He killed the mage, and then the phoenix killed him and the healer. Crimson blamed him for the deaths and kept his CID.
characters.name: Rick

characters.description: A blue-haired UG official with glasses and a laptop who runs the safe zone. After the dwarf attack she tells Ken that a dwarf has marked him and asks him to stay out of public areas. She is Selene's mother and says plainly that Selene's father is in prison. She is keeping watch on Ken because of his ties to the elves.
characters.name: The zone director

characters.description: The UG zone director, now known by name. She is blue-haired, Selene's mother, around her mid-forties in level, and not afraid of Crimson. Her husband is in prison as a UG undercover agent working against Kaiming. She works with Crimson to draw out and destroy a gathering of would-be assassins, then announces penalties against those who worked with Kaiming.
characters.name: Director Amato

characters.description: A woman Ken met on floor 7 who was power-leveled to level 40. She has been messaging with Crimson, who invites her to handle public relations for Silverfangs. Ken agrees to it reluctantly.
characters.name: The influencer

characters.description: An elf with a silver ponytail who serves as a courier between worlds. She brings Ken letters from the elf princess along with an errand related to the metal trade.
characters.name: The royal censor

characters.description: An incubus-type demon lord sealed inside Ken, who acts as his secondary class. He is a level-45 boss that the UG restricts, far too strong for Ken to fight alone. He once gave bonus stats in exchange for smut magazines. When Ken meets him in his mindscape, he confirms that Dez's demonic side belongs to her by blood.
characters.name: Snoo-Snoo

characters.description: A healer with Penny's group whose power moves wounds onto enemies. With Penny, she kills an armored soldier dwarf during the defense of Halen.
characters.name: Dolly

characters.description: The harem queen's real name, revealed through her own point of view. She is Helen's mother, a knight of the mythic flame who wields a blue-fire sword, and her harem's bonds boost her stats. She hates being mistaken for Crimson. During the dwarf invasion she leaves Ken in charge of the students and flies off alone to fight the dwarf queen and her guards.
characters.name: Heather

characters.description: The ruler of the invading dwarf hive. She is nearly nine feet tall, speaks English, and wears chitin armor that repairs itself. She is both a tank and a healer, turns captured humans into drones while taking what was in their CIDs, and treats her soldiers as parts of herself. Five elite soldiers guard her.
characters.name: The dwarf queen

characters.description: The first-person narrator, heir to the Nagato assassin clan and guildmaster of Silverfangs. In earlier adventures he survived a smoke-panther trial that granted him Liminal Speed, a skill that builds speed in stacks and can freeze time in proportion to them, and he became Crimson's lover. He helped bring down a dwarf queen and came away with a mana-burn injury to his arm, and his party also survived an attack by the remnants of the Kai Ming group.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: The Halen instructor in charge of Ken's class and his demanding trainer. She gained her Limit Break from a trial much like the one that gave Ken his speed, and she and Ken are now lovers, which lets her use his portal ability. She keeps up a long-running rivalry with Heather, the teacher of the neighboring class.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: Known as the Harem Queen, she teaches Class 2B, the class next door to Ken's, and is a rival of Crimson. In the previous book she killed an attacking dwarf queen with Ken's help, an encounter that left Ken with a mana-burn injury to his arm.
characters.name: Heather

characters.description: An elf and one of Ken's partners, serving as the main tank of his party. She expects to miss Harley now that the bard is spending most of her time with a separate healer group being formed for the coming raid.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: A demonic mage in Ken's party and one of his partners. Changes over the summer have altered her appearance, most visibly giving her pinker eyes. She is quick to scheme and makes no secret of her affection for Ken.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: A druid and the healer of Ken's party, close to him and protective of his health. She spent time fussing over the mana-burn injury to his arm, and her training over the break has left her noticeably more mature.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: A cat-person shaman who has taken to wearing human clothes. She has stepped into Harley's place in Ken's party and is performing well there as the class arrives for a large vampire-castle event on the 28th floor.
characters.name: Feline

characters.description: A pink-haired bard who is still technically a member of Ken's party but now spends most of her time with a three-person healer group. She is recruiting healers for that group so it can field its own party in the upcoming raid, a plan Ken supports.
characters.name: Harley

characters.description: A blue-haired Frost Knight in Ken's class who is clearly eager to see him again when the class gathers through Crimson's portal for the vampire-castle event on the 28th floor.
characters.name: Penny

characters.description: A student in Ken's class who reads entries from the dungeon almanac aloud as the class prepares for the vampire-castle event on the 28th floor.
characters.name: Candice

characters.description: The leader of the senior class, who joins the vampire-castle trip because rising graduation requirements push the seniors to keep out-leveling the second-years in Ken's class.
characters.name: Senior-class president

characters.description: A red-haired, winged tank in Ken's class who fights with a shield. When Ken rushes into the vampire boss's chamber alone and is nearly killed, she arrives with the others and takes a rapier strike that was aimed at him.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A classmate who mixes healing and damage, draining life from vampires and redirecting it to wounded allies. During the rescue of an overwhelmed group of seniors, she and Candice speak bluntly to the seniors about the risks they took.
characters.name: Selene

characters.description: A well-known social-media influencer who handles public relations for Silverfangs. Crimson brings her to the event camp, where she arrives with assistants and begins preparing Ken and Feline for media interviews, saying the image of the cat-people needs careful handling.
characters.name: Silverfangs PR lead

characters.description: Ken's masked, white-haired butler and a trained Nagato ninja. She delivers a letter from his grandparents asking him to scout a target and decide on a contract himself, then joins him as his pretend date for the job. She collects speed abilities, including a sprint and a teleport, and can switch between personas instantly.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: The target named in the contract Ken's grandparents ask him to scout. He is recorded as a level 38 elemental fighter who styles himself king of the 30th-floor safe zone, and a small guild accuses him of taking its members' CIDs and inventories and acting like a warlord.
characters.name: The safe-zone ruler

characters.description: A tired but friendly administrator who greets Ken and Amy at the 30th-floor safe zone and guides them around. He says he has not left the zone in three years, and he shows them a village where few residents own CIDs or decent gear.
characters.name: Henry

characters.description: One of the two women seated with the safe-zone ruler. She keeps the trade records, runs the ruler's trade, and shows Ken and Amy to their room. She is eager to buy foam for filling the walls and does not appear to be held against her will.
characters.name: The bookkeeper

characters.description: The second woman at the safe-zone ruler's side. Her travel skill lets her turn into a whirlwind and carry others, so she serves as a kind of taxi for the household, and the ruler does not regard her as a planner.
characters.name: The whirlwind woman

characters.description: Charlotte's rabbit companion, who guards her closely and reacts to the jokes around him.
characters.name: Bun-Bun

characters.description: A handsome Royal Academy student, the son of an emir, who carries a saber and expensive gear. He steps in after Crimson injures a Royal Academy student who pointed at Ken, claims to have met Crimson before, and accuses Ken's group of leaning on her to farm crystals and win the raid competition.
characters.name: The prince

characters.description: The blonde class president of the Trusk school, a dragon summoner who calls herself the best summoner in the world and is adored by her classmates. A fan of the web serial about Ken's group, she challenges Ken to a wager on the college raid competition: if she wins he becomes her pet, and if he wins she becomes his dress-up doll.
characters.name: Trusk class president

characters.description: An old high-school acquaintance of Ken who is now a berserker with a mohawk-style haircut and the leader of his Pendulum class, a role he won by going berserk and beating his challengers. A friendly rival, he tells Ken about the upcoming DPS test and the betting already running on it.
characters.name: Pendulum class leader

characters.description: The Royal Academy's professor, one of three rival instructors Crimson confronts and beats. He holds the betting on the inter-school contest, bullies others, and cannot see Ken's UG stats because they are locked.
characters.name: Royal Academy professor

characters.description: The professor from the Pendulum college, one of the three rival instructors Crimson confronts and defeats after learning that the schools kept the betting on the contest hidden from her. Like the other two, he is unable to view Ken's UG stats, which are locked.
characters.name: Pendulum professor

characters.description: Ken's grandmother, a healer with a sadistic streak and an expert in torture who also works on CIDs. Brought in by portal after Ken's job in the safe zone, she and another grandmother crack the locked CIDs the party recovered and clear out the castle's server area.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: Ken's grandfather, who arrives after the safe-zone job. He is fast and flirtatious, takes an immediate liking to Feline, and quizzes her about cat-person bodies based on what he has read in adult comics.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: The prince's bodyguard, a level 52 strength-based fighter with a history as a mass murderer. On the prince's order he crushes Ken's shoulder during their confrontation in the safe zone.
characters.name: George

characters.description: An elf princess with red hair who is Ken's wife by elven ritual and calls herself an empress. Warm toward Ken and commanding toward her guards, she agrees to join his class for the floor-32 raid despite her father's wish that she stay home.
characters.name: The elf princess

characters.description: The elf princess's aunt, a sensor who serves as her close guard. She is strong enough to break swords and keeps a careful watch over her niece.
characters.name: The princess's aunt

characters.description: A junior royal censor who is present with the elf princess at the Elven Palace and accompanies her among her guards.
characters.name: The junior royal censor

characters.description: An elf mercenary sensor at level 68, hired to spar with Ken at the Elven Palace. She relies on brute force, and her area shockwaves outlast his speed stacks and kill him before he is revived.
characters.name: Miriam

characters.description: A Pendulum berserker and Ken's old high-school friend who leads his class. In the DPS test he posts 1,271, likely helped by an extra healer and no tank. He was earlier seen surrounded by eight women at a safe-zone bar.
characters.name: Makin

characters.description: The president of the UG, a large summoner whose scars turn into winged warriors. He visits Ken's camp to brief the elves, reporting that the Naga have pulled back. Crimson mocks him as a coward for hanging back during an old raid, and he asks questions about the destroyed safe zone.
characters.name: UG president

recaps.ending: Ken finishes the book at level 31 with the top DPS score among the four colleges. He has fresh skills swapped with Dez and the elf princess and is back in heavy weighted training under Crimson for the floor-32 raid, which runs on a rotation of two training days and one raid day, shared with the other schools every four days, across four difficulty tiers. The safe-zone contract is done. The ruler, his whirlwind courier, the SJS fixer and the prince's lawyer are dead, and the castle has been destroyed and absorbed by the dungeon, its remaining occupants feared dead. The clan says it lacks the evidence to act. Amy has handed the UG president a folder on the missing debtors, and he suspects more than Ken admits. The prince has been humiliated and outscored, owes a debt from the DPS-test betting that is to be paid through the UG over several days, knows Ken is the Nagato heir, and has ordered a hit on Ken and the princess. Crimson has joined Silverfangs, and Ken can restrain her Limit Break by snapping her choker. Dez keeps her Portal secret, Feline is a full member of Ken's pride with her marriage question unsettled, and Fayeth and Charlotte stay in the party. Penny's family depends on a Silverfangs loan, and Harley runs a healer group inside the guild. The Naga have pulled back, the elves hold the entrance to the floor-70 safe zone, and Charlotte's parents are pushing toward floor 60. Still open are the prince's 20-billion-ren wager against Ken's class on the raid, with Crimson as the stake, the prince's hit, the Trusk president's own raid wager, and the jealousies around the princess.
recaps.in_short: Ken's class farms a vampire-castle event on floor 28 to prepare for an inter-college raid on floor 32. His grandparents hand him his first independent clan job: judge whether to kill the self-made king of a remote 30th-floor safe zone. Undercover with his butler Amy, Ken finds that the ruler is a warden running a forced-labor prison camp. Amy then ties a string of missing debtors to the SJS Financial Group, run by the father of a Royal Academy prince who bets 20 billion ren against Crimson that his school will beat Ken's class. Ken's party raids the castle, kills the ruler and his allies, and learns that the bookkeeper was an SJS fixer who had killed critics of the prince. When the prince's bodyguard crushes Ken's shoulder, Crimson kills the bodyguard and kills the prince once before he is revived, all in front of witnesses, and the schools and the UG agree to stop interfering. Ken's elven wife, the princess, joins his class, and Feline joins his pride. At the DPS test Ken scores 9,021, far ahead of the prince. The book closes with the raid about to begin, the 20-billion-ren wager still unresolved, and the prince's hit on Ken and the princess still in place.

recaps.text: Previously: Ken Nagato, heir to the Nagato assassin clan and guildmaster of Silverfangs, is a second-year at Halen, a school that trains dungeon divers. After the Naga invaded, the headmistress began raising the level required to graduate and pressed the upperclassmen to keep ahead of Ken's class. Ken faced a dungeon trial in which a smoke panther killed him again and again until he finally beat it and earned Liminal Speed, a skill that keeps stacking speed and can freeze time in proportion to the stacks. His instructor Crimson earned her Limit Break through a similar trial. She and Ken became lovers, and she can now use his portal ability. When a dwarf queen attacked the safe zone, Heather, the Harem Queen who teaches the neighboring class and is Crimson's rival, killed the queen with Ken's help, and Ken took a mana-burn injury to his arm. The remaining members of the Kai Ming group then attacked Ken's party, which survived thanks to a new skill of his. Ken's party includes the elf tank Fayeth, the demonic mage Dez and the druid healer Charlotte, all of whom are close to him, along with the bard Harley. The class is now heading to a grind event to prepare for a raid on the 32nd floor.

So far this book: Crimson portals Ken's party to a meeting area, where Classes 2A and 2B and some seniors gather for a vampire-castle event on the 28th floor of a distant dungeon branch. Defeated vampires feed a hidden blood orb that spawns the boss, and Crimson wants the students to practice fighting humanoids at a larger scale before the raid. Ken, now out of his sling, uses new blades from Heather and a new skill, Triple Breach. He races alone to the basement, where the forming boss traps him, drains his stats and nearly kills him. Helen arrives with the others, takes a rapier blow meant for him, and the group finishes the boss. Ken beats an outside adventurer to the loot and divides it among the groups. He admits he fears outgrowing his party, and Dez and Charlotte reassure him. Dez mentions that the elf princess might join the class this semester. Crimson reports on the rival schools: the Royal Academy has a fighter power-leveled into the mid-40s, Trusk relies on summoners, and Pendulum is the strongest and best coordinated. She restarts Ken's heavy training with weights. When a senior asks for help, Ken takes a small team and rescues three Halen parties overwhelmed by vampire casters, and his group scolds the seniors for the risk. Crimson then kills the boss to reset the event. Over the following days the class farms the event and trains, and the Silverfangs PR lead arrives to prepare Ken and Feline for interviews. In a mock session Feline bristles at questions about her home and says she has marked Ken with ink and wants to join his pride.

So far this book: Ken's butler Amy brings a letter from his grandparents. They want him to scout a target in the 30th-floor safe zone and decide himself whether the Nagato clan accepts the contract. A small guild accuses the target, a level 38 elemental fighter calling himself king, of taking members' CIDs and inventories. Ken and Amy pose as a couple and are met by Henry, an administrator who has not left in three years. The villagers have few CIDs or gear, while well-equipped nobles lounge in the castle. The ruler offers a free stay, and his bookkeeper handles trade. Amy fakes loud lovemaking in their room to cover their conversation. At dinner Ken learns that food is the currency and that the villagers are kept dependent, unable to afford the trip out. He trades cream for a staff for Charlotte and a belt for Amy. In private the ruler admits he is really a warden, that the nobles are prisoners who help run the zone, and that the guests seem suspicious, so he posts a watcher. Crimson and Dez portal in, and Ken asks Amy to look into the hosts and into Henry.

So far this book: Ken and Amy leave the safe zone, and Amy returns to the clan to investigate. Over a week of farming Ken reaches level 30 and gains Arcane Singularity, which pulls nearby spells into a short absorb. His training under Crimson grows heavier, and Fayeth shows how much stronger she has become with a massive new shield. She insists the whole party will join any action against the warden, though Ken has not decided to take the job. Charlotte heals Ken after a punishing spar, learns Crimson has been feeding him stamina potions, and secures a promise of more rest. Feline explains that she wants to join Ken's pride because he completed the shaman's trial and she sees him as an equal. She asks for a date, which becomes a night hunt. Crimson portals them to floor 34, where Feline kills boars with spear and ice while Ken takes a gash watching her. He uses Eyes of Wisdom, a skill borrowed from a partner, and Feline guesses it came from Crimson. At camp the two grow intimate, and Feline explains that among her people a heat-bond is a serious step and a shaman's tattoo marks pregnancy or marriage. Ken formally asks her to join his pride and she accepts.

So far this book: Amy returns with her findings. The ruler's whirlwind courier is a former unlicensed taxi worker, and the bookkeeper cannot be traced at all. She found 27 missing adventurers between levels 20 and 35, each owing more than 10 million to the SJS Financial Group, a bank that sponsors the Royal Academy, with no recorded repayments. Ken decides the safe zone is wrong and accepts the contract as his first independent job, planning to keep Crimson and Heather out of it and to send ordinary prisoners to the UG. Dez suggests interrogating the bookkeeper. On a break day in the safe zone above the raid floor, a Royal Academy student insults the group and Crimson severs her finger, and UG guards back off when their CIDs flag Crimson and Ken as marked. An emir's son, a Royal Academy prince, defends the student. He reveals that his father runs SJS, which backs both the Royal Academy and the UG, and demands a wager: 20 billion ren against Crimson herself, on whether his school beats Ken's class in the raid. Crimson agrees as motivation for Ken, and a UG director witnesses the bet.

So far this book: Trusk students recognize Ken's party from a web serial about them called 74 Wives. Their class president, a dragon summoner, wagers that Ken becomes her pet if Trusk wins the raid contest and that she becomes his dress-up doll if he wins, and Dez accepts for him. Ken's old high-school acquaintance, now a berserker leading the Pendulum class, tells them about a DPS test in two weeks, and Ken's party bets heavily on Ken at long odds. Charlotte worries about being replaced, and Ken assures her she never will be. She says her parents have joined a deep dive aiming for the 60th-floor safe zone. Dez gains Portal and is told to keep it quiet. Crimson beats the rival professors, furious that she was made a prize, and bets heavily on Ken, including 5 billion on the DPS check. Ken buys Static Swords and new gear, and Crimson trains him under her new gravity field. Amy confirms the grandparents will keep the hiring group quiet, and Crimson will serve as Ken's alibi. The party infiltrates the castle at night, kills guards and nobles, and breaks into an inner room holding the ruler, the whirlwind woman, the bookkeeper, a man in a maroon suit and banks of servers.

So far this book: The level 40 ruler knocks Ken out while the bookkeeper walls the party apart with barriers. Ken breaks through using Metamorphosis, and Dez, Fayeth, Feline, Charlotte and Bun-Bun bring the ruler down, Fayeth finishing him with her fists. The bookkeeper escapes by whirlwind, and Ken slaughters the remaining nobles in demon form, chases the whirlwind to the stairs, and kills the courier. The man in the maroon suit, the prince's lawyer, also dies. The bookkeeper confesses that she is a former lawyer and fixer for SJS who killed a reporter and an influencer for criticizing the prince. Ken kills her and takes her CID, staff and a locket. Dez brings in Ken's grandmothers, who crack the locked CIDs, and Ken learns SJS already hates his family. That night Ken humiliates the prince at a bar. Later the prince announces he is heading to a dead branch, so Ken stalls him. The prince's bodyguard George crushes Ken's shoulder on the prince's orders. Crimson kills George and then the prince, whom Charlotte revives. Crimson kills George 23 times as the prince revives him, until the prince collapses. The professors and the UG agree to stop interfering, and Ken snaps Crimson's choker to bring her back under control.

So far this book: Ken's family takes the safe-zone loot. The class is one member short of a full 25-person raid. Crimson agrees to take Ken to the elven world after 20 hours of weighted sparring, and at the Elven Palace a level 68 mercenary named Miriam kills him in a spar before he is revived. The elf princess, Ken's wife by elven ritual, agrees to join the raid against her father's wishes and returns with Ken to the class, where she and Dez quickly become rivals. Penny reveals her father's guild has collapsed after two officers proved tied to Kai Ming, and Ken offers a Silverfangs loan for her mother's restart in a dead branch. Penny wants a lasting place in Silverfangs. Amy reports that SJS was involved in the safe zone and that the prince had bought debt from high-level adventurers. When Ken's grandfather checked the site, he found the castle blown apart and being absorbed by the dungeon, with everyone inside feared dead. The clan sees too little evidence to act. The princess offers to pressure SJS through elven trade, and Ken reveals in an interview that Crimson has joined Silverfangs. Feline's heat keeps her with Ken for twelve hours. He reaches level 31 before the competition.

So far this book: All four colleges gather on floor 32 for the DPS test, with a Pendulum professor running it against a raid beetle. Dez leads early with 581 and the princess posts 523. The prince offers to return half his bet, insults Ken, Crimson and the unrecognized princess, and reveals he knows Ken is the last Nagato heir and that his father would fund the clan's ruin. A crushing wave of bloodlust drops his followers, and the princess's aunt threatens him. Ken's old friend Makin scores 1,271, a Trusk dragon summoner reaches 1,718, and the prince, boosting gear worth over a thousand stats, takes first with 2,198. Ken goes last and kills two beetles in a row. When the Royal Academy professor accuses him of cheating, Ken punches him during frozen time and kills him, and the professor is revived. Ken's estimated 9,021 tops the board, and he declines the Pendulum professor's transfer offer.

To the end: Ken tells the prince his debt will be paid through the UG over several days, and Feline celebrates finishing fifth. The Pendulum professor outlines the raid: four difficulty tiers requiring 12,000 to 25,000 DPS, with teachers going along to revive students. Dez opens a hidden Portal, and Ken spends the night with Dez and the princess, whose class can take on traits of up to three monsters. He uses Absorb to swap skills with both. The UG president then visits, reporting that the Naga have pulled back and the elves hold the floor-70 entrance. The princess refuses further trade after an SJS representative insulted her, and Amy reveals the prince has put out a hit on Ken and the princess. Elf trade now runs only through Ken's deal, with Silverfangs and the Nagato taking a 2 percent cut and 15 percent on any deal involving SJS. Amy gives the president a folder on the missing debtors while Ken feigns ignorance. Crimson sets the raid rotation, and Ken returns to training.

characters.description: The narrator, a level 31 melee damage dealer who leads Class 2A of Halen into a 25-person raid on floor 32. His Liminal Speed skill builds attack-speed stacks, and its second phase can stop time for everyone else. He is Crimson's student and lover, and he heads the Silverfangs guild. He has a bet with the prince in which Crimson herself is the stake, and winning it could give Silverfangs a major lift.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: A powerful Halen instructor who trains Ken and is also his lover. She is missing from the floor-32 raid while she works elsewhere. The prince's bet with Ken names her as the prize, so the outcome of the raid matters to her directly.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: A demonic mage and ranged caster in Ken's raid, and one of the women closest to him. She speaks up about tactics from the first pull, suggesting that Helen should handle all the pulling.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: An elf tank who fights with a glaive and draws monster packs with a spore-based pull skill. She is the raid's best tank at controlling groups of enemies, and she is one of Ken's partners. She argues with Helen over who pulls, and the two agree to take turns.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: A green-haired druid and healer in Ken's class who carries her rabbit, Bun-Bun, everywhere. She is one of the women close to Ken.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: Charlotte's rabbit companion, which she carries with her into the raid.
characters.name: Bun-Bun

characters.description: A cat-person shaman close to Ken, who calls him her mate. She formally joins the class raid, taking one of the two places left by classmates who quit, and with her the roster reaches its full 25.
characters.name: Feline

characters.description: A tall, blue-haired frost tank whom Ken counts among the classmates he trusts. She is the backup tank on the first boss. She praises Ken's result on the recent damage check and blushes around him.
characters.name: Penny

characters.description: A blonde arcane weaver who casts runes and keeps her uniform spotless. She is the raid's strategist and explains each boss's mechanics. She also holds the loot as the neutral keeper until payouts are decided. She sides with Ken on starting with the easiest quadrant.
characters.name: Candice

characters.description: A classmate who leads a group of healers in the floor-32 raid.
characters.name: Harley

characters.description: A winged paladin who tanks with a shield. She deals most of her damage when enemies attack her. She wants to open the raid in the middle quadrant and keeps clashing with Fayeth over pulling until they agree to alternate.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A healer whose style hurts enemies and heals the whole raid at the same time. In the necromancer fight she is the most efficient healer the class has. She also has a sharp, teasing sense of humor that she aims at her fellow healers.
characters.name: Selene

characters.description: A priest and healer in the raid. She is Penny's cousin and Harley's girlfriend. After the first wipe she argues that Harley should be revived first, since Harley restores the healers' mana.
characters.name: Meredith

characters.description: An elven royal in Ken's class and one of the women close to him. She stays out of classroom disputes and enjoys the break from court politics that the raid gives her.
characters.name: The elf princess

characters.description: An arrogant young man whom Ken has met several times. He made a bet with Ken in which Crimson is the stake, and he treats Ken as a rival.
characters.name: The prince

characters.description: A Class C professor from Halen who supervises the class's floor-32 raid while Crimson is away. No high-level tanks or healers come along this time, and her job is to make sure fallen students are revived after a wipe.
characters.name: Halen Class C professor

characters.description: A top-level elven royal censor who guards Ken at the princess's request. She spars with him while Candice records data, and he beats her only after his Liminal Speed builds up. Afterward she points out that an assassin should not be expected to win a fair fight.
characters.name: The chief royal censor

characters.description: An enchanter in Ken's class who mostly buffs the tanks and supports the healers. Ken and Candice decide the raid has more healing than it needs and want her to buff the melee damage dealers.
characters.name: Kendra

characters.description: Ken's grandfather and an elder of the Nagato clan. He arrives at the dungeon with Ken's three grandmothers and reports that the princess's business through Silverfangs has made the family billionaires. He tests Ken with a surprise attack, then joins him for a meal in his tent.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: One of Ken's three grandmothers. She is known for a sadistic streak. She comes to the dungeon with Ken's grandfather and the other grandmothers and visits Ken's camp.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: The berserker who leads the Pendulum college's group. When an earthquake cuts the dungeon off, he joins Ken, the professors and the prince to plan a route to the floor-30 safe zone.
characters.name: Pendulum berserker

characters.description: A male professor from the Royal College who sits in on the leaders' meeting after the earthquake, when the colleges plan how to reach the floor-30 safe zone and restore contact.
characters.name: Royal College professor

characters.description: A senior elven royal censor whose mercenary class grows stronger as she earns money. The Emperor once expelled her and put a bounty on her, and she worked underground as Madam Root before recently returning to the censors. She runs a network of informants among human adventurers and is immensely strong.
characters.name: Older royal censor

characters.description: A younger elven royal censor who can move through darkness at speed, taking one passenger with her. After the dungeon shifts and cuts her off from the princess, she and the older censor decide to push as deep as they can to reach her.
characters.name: Junior royal censor

characters.description: A black-haired Royal College student in gold jewelry who is a distant relative of the SJS family. She comes to Ken offering to throw her college's raid attempt and to give testimony if he protects her, but she refuses to be recorded. Ken declines her offer.
characters.name: Royal College student

characters.description: The leader of the Trusk college's class and an ally of Ken on the stranded colleges' council. With Pendulum and Ken, she votes to leave the raid when food runs low. Her college's summoners had earlier hidden the raid entrance under sand.
characters.name: Trusk class leader

characters.description: A dwarf queen of roughly level 50. Trusk scouts report that she leads around 500 dwarves in an assault on the Naga, who are defending the floor-35 boss door and the way into the safe zone. She stands between the alliance and safety.
characters.name: Dwarf queen

characters.description: A demon sealed inside Ken, carried over from earlier books.
characters.name: The demon sealed in Ken

characters.description: The demon sealed inside Ken, who says he was once third in line for the Demon Lord throne. When Ken meets a floor boss in his likeness, the demon breaks his chains in Ken's mind. He admits he was steering Ken to spare the prince so that he could take the prince's body, with Ken's as a fallback. Freed from the seal, he becomes the boss and vows to claim Ken's body.
characters.name: Snoo-Snoo

characters.description: A winged, angel-like woman who works as the governor's assistant in the vast city found below the boss floor, which she calls Star City. A language skill lets her speak English, which another human living in the city taught her.
characters.name: Winged guide

characters.description: Ken's nickname for Star City's winged guide, since he cannot pronounce her real name. She explains how the city came to be inside the dungeon and who lives there, then leads Ken to Crimson before going her own way.
characters.name: Lulu

characters.description: The governor of Star City, a tall, high-level, green-skinned man in a silk shirt with a monocle and gold-capped tusks. Ken offends him by calling him an orc and then bows, and the governor welcomes the party.
characters.name: Star City governor

characters.description: The head of the UG. The princess says he has assured her that the earlier attempt on her life will not be repeated.
characters.name: UG president

recaps.ending: Ken finishes the book in Star City, a city of permanent dungeon residents linking 70 floors. He has killed both the prince and the demon once sealed inside him. Dez's ritual has changed his body, leaving him taller and paler with ivory hair and golden slit-pupil eyes, and his CID shows nothing but an error. His last stated level is 42. Dez, Charlotte, Bun-Bun, Fayeth and Feline are with him. Crimson, who reached the city months earlier and let his group grow on its own, is back as his instructor and plans to hold class there. She suggests Feline's tattoo as a possible substitute for his broken CID. Penny is alive after being revived, and Ken owes her two unpaid debts, but she is not part of the group that enters Star City. The princess, her aunt and the censors are separated from Ken. The princess still intends to return to the elf world to help her father, and Fayeth's promise to go with her and train has not been carried out. Crimson reports that the prince's assassins poisoned a woman on the elven side with an incurable poison, and the chief censor's own hidden wound is still uncured. The Royal College survivors went their own way, the Naga matriarch was never found, and Crimson's legal fight with SJS, whose finances have suffered, has no resolution. The book does not explain why the dungeon shuffled. The way home still seems to lie deeper. Feline's lost people, the warlord who founded Star City and the human living there all remain unexplored.
recaps.in_short: Ken leads Halen's Class 2A through a floor-32 raid while Crimson is away on UG business, with Crimson herself staked on his bet with the prince. The class learns the raid through repeated wipes and a new officer structure. A massive quake then reshuffles the dungeon and strands four colleges, and the floor-30 safe zone is replaced by a dwarf hive. Ken and the chief royal censor kill four assassins sent against the princess, and the censor hires Ken to kill the prince. The class clears the raid first, and the prince's group fails to force a tie. Starving, the alliance breaks out, and Ken kills a dwarf queen on floor 35. The prince then kills Penny with an arrow and attacks, and Ken kills him. Penny is revived and the Royal College professor dies. On the next boss floor, the demon sealed in Ken breaks free. The boss swallows Ken, and Ken kills the demon in his mind-space, but Dez's ritual wraps him in a blood cocoon, from which he emerges physically changed and with a broken CID. Below, the party discovers Star City, where Crimson has been waiting and announces that class will continue there.

recaps.text: Previously: Ken Nagato is a Halen student and melee damage dealer whose Liminal Speed skill builds attack-speed stacks. He trains under Crimson, a formidable Halen instructor who is also his lover, and he is guildmaster of Silverfangs. His grandparents are elders of the Nagato clan. His closest companions are Dez, a demonic mage; Fayeth, an elf tank; Charlotte, a druid healer who keeps a rabbit named Bun-Bun; Feline, a cat-person shaman who calls Ken her mate; and an elven princess who is bound to Ken by elven ritual. Ken also carries a demon sealed inside him. In earlier books the Naga were a major threat. Crimson slew Naga, and the princess's father went to war against them. The princess has also been targeted before: a rebel faction tried to kill her the previous summer. Shortly before this book opens, Ken's class finished a damage check. Ken has a bet with the prince, an arrogant rival, in which Crimson herself is the stake.

So far this book: A few days after the damage check, Ken leads Class 2A into a 25-person raid on floor 32. Crimson is away on a UG job, so the only senior present is a Class C professor who supervises and makes sure fallen students are revived. Winning the bet with the prince would give Ken the stake he cares about and could boost Silverfangs. Ken starts with the easiest quadrant so the class can build teamwork and gear. Candice serves as strategist and neutral loot keeper. Fayeth and Helen argue over pulling duty until they agree to alternate. The first boss is a giant golden scarab that heals by eating the beetles it spawns. On the first attempt the ranged casters spend their cooldowns too early, and waves of adds outlast the healers' mana. Harley calls a wipe. Ken carries Charlotte out, and everyone else dies and is revived afterward. Feline and the princess take the places of two classmates who quit, filling the roster. The professor runs a debrief. Healers will run to the nearest tank, stuns will be called so they do not overlap, and Ken will leave the boss only for the golden beetles. The second attempt succeeds. Ken finishes the boss with Liminal Speed's second phase, which freezes time for everyone else and uses up his stacks. Candice rolls off four epic drops. The ice mage gets a staff, and Meredith, Harley's girlfriend, gets a gold dress.

So far this book: Before the second boss, Ken tells Feline, Charlotte, Dez, Fayeth and the princess that he will not leave the dungeon without all five of them. The second boss is a giant crocodile in a half-flooded room that keeps spawning crocodiles. It drags tanks under the water and marks one player for every crocodile to chase. After several deaths, including Meredith's, the class learns to use the full length of the dry side and its movement skills, and the boss dies after about eight cycles. The third boss is a towering necromancer. He is shielded while three bone adds live: a charging beetle, a caster and a parrot with sonic blasts. Once they die, he spins the bones into a storm. The healers run out of mana, and the raid wipes again and again. Ken accepts that he cannot lead everything from melee and names five officers: Harley, Penny, Dez, Candice and himself. Dez takes over calling formations. Elsewhere, a UG lawyer defends Crimson while SJS Financial's lawyers question her about the prince's bet, her 400-million-ren wager on Ken and her relationship with him, which she admits. The necromancer comes close to dying but then summons every remaining skeleton. The officers move on to the Path of Sands, one of the two three-boss side wings of the trident-shaped raid. Penny says healers must learn to endure pain, and Ken confirms she writes a story about 74 wives. The princess says her guard watches the raid entrance because of past attempts on her life, one of them linked to the prince. She invites Ken to spend summers in the elven realm.

So far this book: The class clears the sand wing and has five bosses down by the end of its first trip, losing two raiders to tornadoes on the way. Because bosses respawn at midnight, no other college can share the raid, and Ken gives the class three days of rest. Outside, the prince taunts Ken. The princess replies that he sent someone to kill her and that she is moving her business through Silverfangs, which leaves his financial group with little more than damage claims. Crimson comes back and says the UG has her looking into strong seismic activity in several dungeon branches and running errands by Portal. Ken suspects she is hiding something more. She says she will stop teaching at Halen after Ken graduates and wants to dive to the bottom of the dungeon with him, and Ken arranges a date. During the break Dez goes with Crimson to collect Portal locations, and the princess keeps attacking the prince's deals. Ken takes Fayeth shopping and has the ring she found in the dungeon upgraded. He also gives her a cheap ring as a joke proposal, and she keeps it. They agree that by elven reckoning they are already soul-bonded and need only a ceremony. Fayeth is royalty too, though far down the elven line of succession. The UG shop is nearly bare because a shipment is late, but Ken buys three cases of stone skin potions for the boss with the sonic parrot. At dinner Fayeth says she would accept more partners, and Ken says he does not plan any.

So far this book: The prince learns that six assassins have turned down his offer. He decides to try again later with a lower price. He also orders that Crimson be tied up in legal depositions and that supplies on floor 35 be bought out, with the shortage blamed on the elves. He means to kill Ken and the princess. At the princess's request, an elven royal censor guards Ken and spars with him. Candice becomes Ken's dedicated support, layering haste and frost runes on him. Ken's grandparents arrive, report that the princess's Silverfangs business has made them billionaires, and test Ken with a surprise attack. On their date, Ken and Crimson go to a traveling fair in disguise and without their CIDs. Crimson loses her temper and flattens a stall, and the two agree to put off children and push to the bottom of the dungeon together. Three weeks into the raid, the class is stuck at eight bosses until it tries an approach built around keeping Ken alive. He dies in the boss's last stage, but the boss falls seconds later, and Ken takes the dagger Umber Heart Sigil. Then a huge earthquake stops everything. Tents collapse, Dez's Portal finds no known locations, and the leaders, including the Pendulum berserker, two visiting professors and the prince, plan to head for the floor-30 safe zone. In a lawsuit meeting with SJS, Crimson sees that Ken's CID signal has vanished. She kills a guard, wrecks half the building and leaves. At floor 30 the censor finds that the safe zone has become a long-established dwarven queen hive. The party fights the drones, and Feline seems to understand what has happened.

So far this book: Two other elven censors, a junior and an older mercenary who once worked underground as Madam Root, learn from an informant about four masked adventurers seen with a Royal College professor. When the stairways shift, the censors find themselves cut off and decide to push deeper to reach the princess. Near floor 35, the Royal College professor signals masked assassins. They stab the Halen professor and leave her to three Naga, but she fakes her death, kills the Naga and heals herself. Back on floor 32, Feline admits that her people live in a dead branch of the dungeon, cut off by a great disaster. Using Eyes of Wisdom, which Crimson shared with him, Ken finds that the routes to Earth and to the elven world both lead downward. He tells the camp the dungeon has shuffled, with dwarves above and Naga in their mid-40s below. The colleges split the raid wings in rotation, and the 20-billion-ren bet with the prince still stands. The Royal College professor returns and claims the Halen professor died saving him, but she reaches Ken that night and warns him. Ken, the chief censor and the professor kill all four assassins, and their leader reveals nothing under questioning. The censor hires Ken to kill the prince, and Ken persuades her to make it look like an accident. Ken puts the assassins' heads on display and publicly accuses the prince, who denies it. The colleges move into the raid's first room and hide the entrance under a dune. Elsewhere, Crimson remaps safe zones and helps reconnect humans and elves. The chief censor shows Ken a poisoned hip wound that gets worse when healed and asks him to keep it secret, even from the princess.

So far this book: A week of grinding takes Ken to level 35. The monsters have each gained a level, which suggests the floor has moved deeper. Feline apologizes for her low mood, and Ken renews his promise to help find her people. The class beats the second-to-last boss, a sea hag, on its second attempt by dodging in a dance-like pattern Ken practices with Penny. The final boss is an undead caster at an altar with four portals. Ken keeps large skeletal adds alive while Helen tanks them so he can build stacks, then burns the boss down on the first try. Penny receives a two-handed sword, Dez a skull belt and Ken a sword called Harbinger of the Endless. Halen is the first college to clear the raid. The prince and the Royal College professor refuse to accept the result. Then the Halen professor appears alive and accuses the Royal College professor of leaving her to die, and Ken shows the assassins' heads. Ken agrees that the prince has until the end of the next day to beat the boss and force a tie on the notarized bet, and Harley and Charlotte record the exchange. A Royal College student, a distant relative of the SJS family, offers to sabotage her college's attempt and to testify in exchange for protection, but she will not be recorded. Ken turns her down.

So far this book: The colleges celebrate in their sealed camp with Harley's spiked punch and Fayeth's cooking. Ken dances with Selene and Penny, and he spends the night with Dez and Feline in his tent. The prince's group fails to beat the final boss. About two months after what is now called the Great Shuffle, when the dungeon rearranged itself and stranded many adventurers, Ken's grandparents and Silverfangs are clearing dwarf and Naga incursions in Norway and looking for survivors. Crimson confirms that Ken is safe and pulls trapped adventurers out by Portal for an overstretched UG. Inside the raid, Ken has reached level 42, the monsters gain a level every week, and the food is almost gone, with crocodile meat the only edible drop. Ken calls a council vote on leaving. Pendulum, Trusk and Ken vote yes, and the Halen professor joins them because the camp is starving. The Royal College professor stalls and the prince obstructs. Ken says the way home lies deeper but will not explain how he knows, and he tells his class to pack up and dig the entrance clear.

So far this book: Outside the raid, the alliance wipes out a group of fighting Naga and dwarves, and the souls of enemies Ken kills rise as temporary specters that fight for him. The colleges sweep down to floor 35, where Trusk scouts find about 500 dwarves and a dwarf queen of roughly level 50 attacking the Naga near the boss room and the safe zone entrance. The Royal College never arrives, so the alliance attacks without it. The Pendulum berserker holds the boss door while Ken flanks along the wall, cancels the Naga casters' spells with Arcane Singularity and collects more specters. Ken, Dez, Charlotte, Fayeth, Feline and Penny then take on the queen, who is fast, regenerates and raises dead drones. Ken uses Metamorphosis and skills borrowed from his partners. Penny's frost and Feline's spear help crack the queen's armor, and Ken stops time and beheads her. Then a huge arrow from the prince kills Penny, and the starving Royal College attacks over food. The prince boasts that he knew Ken's plans, set a trap and had the elf censor poisoned with healer's bane. As an artificer, he can wear and amplify extra gear, and he resists mana burn. Ken's Absorb and Spell Mirror give him an opening. He stops time, cuts off the prince's hand, leaves the Royal College professor badly wounded and beheads the prince.

So far this book: Ken takes the prince's CID, which is full of food and high-level gear. He refuses the Royal College professor's demand for it and tells the Royal College to fight the dwarves or die. He revives Penny, who says he now owes her two debts. Feline kills the wounded professor. Without their queen the dwarves collapse, the Naga are nearly wiped out, and the alliance secures the safe zone, though no Naga matriarch is found. The Trusk leader holds it with dragon summons. The Royal College is kept under guard and later leaves in the other direction. Scouting the lava floor below, Ken, Penny and Charlotte kill a succubus and demonic boars whose meat is edible. Ken's demon seal grows warm, and Eyes of Wisdom still points deeper. The princess tells Ken that once Crimson returns, she must go back to the elf world to help her father. Her guard offers to train Fayeth there, and Fayeth agrees. Ken starts thinking of Penny as a replacement tank. Elsewhere, Crimson meets the UG president, who is planning strike teams against dwarf colonies. She says she has already found Ken's raid but will leave him there because his growth is not finished. Ken's party finds the next boss door open, with a level-55 boss floor beyond it.

So far this book: The floor boss is a lounging demon lord who looks exactly like the demon sealed in Ken. Ken's seal burns and pulls him into his mind-space. There the demon, Snoo-Snoo, breaks his chains and admits he had been steering Ken to spare the prince so he could take the prince's body, with Ken's as a fallback. The seal breaks and the demon is driven out. The boss locks the room and declares he will take Ken's body, and the party learns the demon's name for the first time. The boss ignores the tank to chase Ken and grows to about forty feet tall. A charm wave freezes the women but not Bun-Bun, whose interference lets them recover. Dez draws a giant pentagram for a Renard family ritual and asks Ken to wear the boss down. Ken fights with chains, the room's obstacles and his full set of skills until purple flames cut them off from the others. The boss turns to blood and swallows Ken. In his mind-space, Ken duels the demon using Liminal Speed and Liminal Space, outlasts his stacks, tears out his throat and drains him, and the demon dies conceding defeat. The blood then seals Ken in a cocoon. Dez admits this outcome is not in her book. She had meant to upgrade Ken's demon blood, not kill the boss, and Fayeth blames her.

So far this book: Dez stops the others from cutting the cocoon open or forcing the doors, and the golden chains on the doors fall away. Ken comes out as himself but changed. He is a few inches taller and paler, with curly ivory-white hair and golden slit-pupil eyes, and his CID shows only an error. Dez nicknames him Incubus Ken. Worried about how people on the surface will react, the party scouts the stairs and finds a huge tiered city that a winged, angel-like guide calls Star City. Ken offends its green-skinned governor by calling him an orc, then bows, and the party is welcomed. Ken nicknames the guide Lulu. She explains that a warlord above level 100 carved the city into the dungeon. It links 70 floors and is home to people who live in the dungeon for good, including the winged people, cat-people, dwarves and Naga. At an inn, Ken finds Crimson, who has been in the city for months and knew where his group was. She reports heavy losses among Earth's adventurers. She also says the prince's assassins poisoned a woman on the elven side with an incurable poison, and she blames the censors for failing to prevent it. Crimson suggests Feline's tattoo might stand in for Ken's broken CID. The book ends with Crimson announcing that class will continue in Star City. Ken, Dez, Charlotte, Fayeth and Feline are with her, while the princess, her aunt and the censors are elsewhere.

characters.description: The narrator and heir of the Nagato clan, now a white-haired demon of the incubus type. In Star City, Feline's ritual expands the tattoo on his back to show a readable sheet: his class has become Emperor, his secondary class is gone, and he has demon skills such as True Demon Form and Demon Rank, which grows stronger with the number and rank of those he rules. He tells Crimson he killed the prince after the prince turned on the group, and he confirms he will keep diving.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: Ken's lover and the most powerful human diver, a limit-break user who has spent about a week in Star City and keeps a suite there. She is affectionate and possessive with Ken. She insists the other student groups must reach the city on their own because its green-skinned rulers forbid carrying people in, and she promises to deal with any fallout from the prince's death.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: A cat-person shaman in Ken's party. She performs the ritual that expands the tattoo on Ken's back, making his changed abilities readable again, and she reads his new skills aloud to the group.
characters.name: Feline

characters.description: A member of Ken's party and one of his partners. When Feline's ritual reveals Ken's new sheet, Dez takes a photo of it, studies it, and names him an incubus.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: An elf who serves as the party's tank and cook and is one of Ken's partners. When the party decides to take the elf princess and the chief censor back to the elven world, Fayeth is set to go with them, and she says little about leaving.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: An elf princess and one of Ken's partners, whom he married in the elven world in a ceremony that took the place of a forced marriage. Now that the survivors have reached Star City, the party plans to take her and the chief censor back to the elven world, and Fayeth is to travel with them.
characters.name: Elf princess

characters.description: A druid healer in Ken's party who summons the rabbit Bun-Bun. Back on Earth after the dungeon trip to Star City, she contacts her family.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: A tall student tank with royal-blue hair who wears black steel gear with green trim. She fought during the dungeon shuffle alongside Helen and secretly writes the racy novel "74 Wives". Her father, a guild member in the upper 40s, wants her to quit school, but she turns down his guild and accepts Ken's formal invitation to become his party's tank once the elves leave.
characters.name: Penny

characters.description: An elf swordswoman who guards the elf princess. Now that the survivors have reached Star City, the party plans to escort her back to the elven world together with the princess, with Fayeth going along.
characters.name: Chief censor

characters.description: A black-winged, red-eyed angel in Star City, taller than most of her kind and regarded by other angels as an oddity. Crimson hires her as a guide at three red mana crystals a day, and she is bound to keep a client's business private. She cannot leave the city. She tells Ken that demons are respected there and warns him to keep quiet about being a new one.
characters.name: Ambrosia

characters.description: The headmistress of Halen, who can open portals to the surface of Earth. She is shocked that the Royal College group is missing and that Ken's level now equals hers.
characters.name: Headmistress Marlow

characters.description: The head of the Nagato household, who fondly calls Fayeth his favorite daughter-in-law. Ken lies to him about some magazines to placate Crimson. He goes with Ken's group through Crimson's portal to the SJS offices in New York.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: Ken's two grandmothers, trained assassins who know a great deal about poisons. Ken asks them to treat the ailing elf chief censor, and she stays in their care.
characters.name: Ken's grandmothers

characters.description: The president of SJS Financial and father of the prince Ken killed, whom he closely resembles. His guards include a man the prince once revived. Ken is coming to collect a 20-billion-ren bet from him.
characters.name: SJS head

characters.description: The unnamed head of the UG. At the Nagato dining hall, the UG leadership hears Ken and Crimson's account of the dungeon and Star City, agrees to enforce the rule that people must reach the city on their own, and plans to claim the closest safe zone on the route.
characters.name: UG president

characters.description: Charlotte's father. Through Charlotte, he asks Ken to find his eldest daughter, Alice, who has been missing since the dungeon shuffle.
characters.name: Marcus

characters.description: Charlotte's eldest sister, as tough as their mother, who has been missing since the dungeon shuffle. Charlotte is not close to her. Ken's Eyes of Wisdom shows she is still alive inside the dungeon.
characters.name: Alice

characters.description: The ruler of the elves and Ellie's father. When Crimson's portal brings the group to his palace balcony, he greets his daughter in public and asks after two escorts who were left in a safe zone before the shuffle went wrong. Nobody has seen them.
characters.name: Elven emperor

characters.description: Two escorts of the elf princess who were left behind in a safe zone before the dungeon shuffle went wrong. The elven emperor asks about them, but nobody has seen them, and their whereabouts are unknown.
characters.name: Missing elf escorts

characters.description: The rabbit Charlotte summons. He can be bribed with carrots.
characters.name: Bun-Bun

characters.description: The stubborn leader of a cat-person party in the safe zone below the 50th floor. He is suspicious of Ken and assumes Feline is under his control. He tells her she could be taken in by a clan, and she refuses.
characters.name: Lion-maned cat-person

characters.description: A powerful, commanding cat-person shaman from the settlement where Alice's group was held. She arrives with the lion-maned man, names Feline as a member of the Spirit Tiger tribe and Ken as an incubus, and demands that both of them remain.
characters.name: Elder cat-person shaman

characters.description: A lion-type cat-person who is second in command at the settlement and a skilled swordsman. He resents Ken, believing Ken has brainwashed Feline. When Feline reveals that Ken was once human, the guard attacks him, and Feline cuts his face. After the elder shaman breaks Ken's legs, the guard hauls him to the house where Alice's group had been kept and locks him inside.
characters.name: Lion-type cat-person guard

characters.description: A large judge from the green-skinned host race who wears implanted devices and puts rules ahead of fairness. He takes the safe-zone dispute out of the UG's hands, tells the UG it has no power to punish Crimson, and lists complaints about how humans behave in the dungeon. After reading the cat-person wrist disc and speaking with Feline alone, he finds Ken and Crimson at fault for excessive violence.
characters.name: Orc-like arbiter

characters.description: A student in Ken's Halen class whose mother leads the Arcana guild. A healer from another student group has joined that guild.
characters.name: Candice

characters.description: A student in Ken's Halen class who keeps her distance from him. She fought beside Penny during the dungeon shuffle, and her mother has threatened to pull her out of Halen over her grudge against Ken.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A fighter in Ken's Halen class who is rotating into Candice's group when classes resume.
characters.name: Taylor

characters.description: A bard in Ken's class who is careful with money. She agrees reluctantly to chip in on the party's debt and says she wants to meet Feline's cat-person sisters.
characters.name: Harley

characters.description: A student in Ken's class who flirts with him and asks Dez out for coffee.
characters.name: Selene

characters.description: A tall Naga matriarch living in Star City, with six arms, blue-green skin, and a serpent's lower body. She is curious and takes things literally, mistakes Ken for a dwarf, and accepts strength as the basis for leadership. She takes Ken, Penny, and Feline to her favorite pastime, which is watching the angels' bathhouse.
characters.name: Naga matriarch

characters.description: A youthful-looking succubus with pigtails and a spade-tipped tail who has been in Star City for nearly two months. Two hosts are quarreling over her, and four large escorts guard her closely. She greets Ken as a fellow demon who could be an ally, flirts with him, takes an interest in Penny, and shares flower-blood drinks with them.
characters.name: Mel

characters.description: Penny's father, a tall, proud guild leader whose guild began among divers from the public entrance and broke apart after a Naga attack. SJS has bought up his debts, except those the Nagato clan holds, so it can take the safe zone that provides about 70 percent of his guild's income. He is cool toward Ken but agrees to let Ken take over the 200-million debt.
characters.name: Roger

characters.description: A level 51 six-armed Naga matriarch who leads the invasion of Roger's safe zone. She uses her arms to cast buffs, heal, and attack while fighting with two flamberges, and she goes into a frenzy that makes her faster and stronger. Ken kills her with Mana Implosion, and her army falls apart.
characters.name: Invading Naga matriarch

characters.description: A senior UG official and Selene's mother, a polite, demanding businesswoman whose glasses display streaming data. After the Naga attack she gives Ken and Penny the biggest share of the bounty and points out that SJS keeps buying safe zones that were raided by Naga. Suspecting that humans are working with the Naga, she hires the Nagato clan to investigate SJS and to trace the route the Naga used.
characters.name: UG director

characters.description: The previous SJS head's brother, now running SJS Financial. He has redone the office, inherited the company's Naga contact, plans smear campaigns and pressure on the families of Ken's friends, and thinks money protects him. Ken, the UG director, and their allies catch him. He admits that the Kai Ming assassin group worked for SJS and that Ken's mother refused to let the Nagato clan become an SJS tool. Ken beheads him and then revives him, and the UG takes him into custody.
characters.name: New SJS president

characters.description: The UG director's husband, a fighter who moves through shadows and deals harshly with her targets. He comes through Ken's portal with the director and their allies and subdues the new SJS president so the director can question him.
characters.name: UG director's husband

characters.description: A go-between linking the Kai Ming assassins with SJS, and the person closest to the center of the network Ken is working through. Ken captures him in a safe-zone brothel. He reveals that SJS put agents in most of Ken's mother's party to turn her and the Nagato clan, and that a later SJS leader chose to let the clan wither. Ken kills him even though he had promised not to.
characters.name: Kai Ming liaison

recaps.ending: When the book closes, Ken is level 45 at 27 percent, a demon of the incubus subrace with the Emperor class, the Speed trial reward, the Sword of Omens stun, and a sheet that lists his guild as the Silverfangs. Crimson has told him to turn down UG work until the school year and the summer are over and to bring his problems to her. Ken now knows that SJS arranged his mother's death, and he has left jewelry at his parents' shrine. Crimson, at level 67, still teaches the class and plans to steer the party toward the seven trials next year. She trains alone in the gravity room because she fears being overtaken. Penny is now openly Ken's partner, with Roger's blessing. Dez, Charlotte, and Feline stay with him, and Ken has invited Dez to the mountain hideaway. Feline's Spirit Tiger tribe has not been found, and the cat-people of that settlement are hostile toward the party. Fayeth, Ken's fiancee, and the elf princess are helping the elves recover in their own world, and Ken has promised to take the princess back into the dungeon. The two elf escorts left behind in a safe zone have still not been found. In Star City, Ambrosia hopes to train as a diver and may enroll at Halen, the Naga matriarch is helping the party deal with Naga tribes, and Mel is a source of information about the trials. Other threads stay open: the rest of the arbiter's debt, the remaining human contacts of the Naga raiders, and whether SJS will strike back.
recaps.in_short: Back from the dungeon shuffle as a demon of the incubus type, Ken settles into Star City with Crimson, returns the stranded students to Earth, and confronts the head of SJS Financial, who tries to stab him and dies at Ken's hand after Ken has extracted 30 billion ren, the 20-billion bet plus a forced extra payment. Ken gets engaged to Fayeth before she and the elf princess go back to the elven world, then forms a new party with Penny as tank alongside Charlotte, Dez, and Feline. They rescue Charlotte's sister Alice from a cat-person settlement, but the cat-people try to keep Feline. Ken, Crimson, and his grandparents get her back, and Ken kills the settlement's elder shaman. An orc-like arbiter rules that Ken's side bears part of the blame and gives them a debt to pay. Classes resume, and Ken starts dating Penny. He and Penny defend her father's safe zone from a Naga invasion and kill its matriarch. With a friendly Naga matriarch's help, Ken follows the raiders back to SJS, whose new president the UG arrests. Ken learns that SJS arranged his mother's death and hunts down people on a UG list, killing a Kai Ming liaison. Crimson takes him off the job, tells him to train, and plans to push the party toward the dungeon's seven trials.

recaps.text: Previously: Ken Nagato, a student diver from Halen and heir of the Nagato clan, was caught in the dungeon shuffle along with his party and other college groups. The party includes Crimson, his instructor and lover and the strongest human diver; Dez; the druid healer Charlotte and her rabbit Bun-Bun; the elf tank Fayeth; and Feline, a cat-person shaman raised inside the dungeon whom Ken protected during the shuffle. In the elven world Ken married the elf princess, a wedding that took the place of a forced marriage, and the elf chief censor came back from the shuffle poisoned. The princess's two escorts were left in a safe zone before things went wrong. During a battle with the Naga, the Royal College group attacked Ken's party, and the prince betrayed them; Ken killed him. Demon blood turned Ken from a human into a demon. Ken also has an outstanding 20-billion-ren bet with SJS Financial, the company run by the prince's father. The survivors reached Star City, a city deep in the dungeon.

So far this book: In Crimson's suite in Star City, Feline's ritual expands the tattoo on Ken's back so his abilities can be read again. His class has become Emperor, his secondary class is gone, and he has new demon skills, including Demon Rank, which scales with those he rules. Ken tells Crimson he killed the prince and confirms he will keep diving. Crimson insists the other student groups must reach the city under their own power, since the green giants forbid carrying people in. After buying a universal-language skill, Ken learns that Star City is one of seven cities that the shuffle cut off from each other. Crimson hires the black-winged angel Ambrosia as a guide and buys a house on the second tier from the top. Ken finds he can now cast Portal. After a scouting trip toward the elven world, Ken and Crimson find the stranded students of three colleges, and Crimson portals them to Earth. The Royal College group is not among them. At Halen the headmistress learns of the Royal College's attack. Ken's grandmothers take on treating the poisoned chief censor. Ken, Crimson, his grandfather, the princess, and Feline go to SJS in New York. Ken tells the SJS head that he killed his son. He charms the man's two bodyguards, and they use their employer's own credentials to send Ken 30 billion ren. The SJS head attacks Ken with a dagger, and Ken kills him. Ken, now bolder and taking the lead, says his mother was killed by a rival clan. Crimson warns that the UG and the top guilds will now turn their attention to the Nagato clan.

So far this book: At the Nagato estate, Ken and Crimson brief the UG president and representatives of the top guilds. The UG agrees to enforce the rule that people reach Star City on their own and plans to claim the nearest safe zone on the way. Ken formally asks Penny, a blue-haired tank, to join his party, and she turns down her father's guild to do it. About eight students plan to drop out, but the headmistress wants training to go on with Crimson as teacher near Star City. Ken agrees to portal returning students there in three days. Crimson leaves with the chief censor to find a route to the elves. Charlotte tells Ken that her father, Marcus, wants help finding her eldest sister Alice, who has been missing since the shuffle. Eyes of Wisdom shows Alice is alive in the dungeon, and Ken agrees to search for her. The headmistress portals Ken, Fayeth, and the princess, called Ellie, to Tuscany in return for a favor: Ken must get the students back to classroom training. At dinner Ken proposes to Fayeth, and she accepts. Before leaving, Fayeth explains that the princess needs someone she trusts while she works to restore the elves. Ellie and Fayeth both learn Portal, and Crimson takes them to the elven emperor's palace. The emperor, Ellie's father, asks about two escorts left in a safe zone, but nobody has seen them. Ken then meets his party members' parents, promises Marcus he will find Alice, and Crimson takes his malfunctioning CID to be repaired.

So far this book: Ken's new party has Penny as tank, Charlotte as healer, Dez and Ken as damage, and Feline in a flexible support role. On the way down below Star City, Bun-Bun, whom Ken cannot understand because universal language does not work on him, knocks Charlotte off a bridge; Feline and Ken save her, and she angrily unsummons him. Their first floor below the city is a misty graveyard. Dez turns out to fear ghosts, and Penny learns to kite zombies with ice spikes. They defeat a zombie carrying a coffin, camp on floor 48 near peaceful orc-like farmers, and beat the floor-50 boss, a Crypt Keeper with a lantern that spreads mist, using Ken's Triple Breach and a second phase of Liminal Speed. In the safe zone below, a cat-person party led by a lion-maned man suspects Ken controls Feline. Feline learns that other cat-people worship a goddess, which shakes her faith in the dungeon she calls the Great One. She refuses to leave Ken, saying she owes him her life. Fearing an ambush, the party portals back to Star City, where Penny learns to cook and they set up a meal rotation.
